note: handle_destination_sync(job_id, {workspace_id, run_id}) against an in-memory database and scripted deliverers, clock frozen at 2026-08-29T10:40:00Z (started_at/finished_at/delivered_at/last_success_at are real values here). run-1 is the run under test (created 2026-08-02), run-0 an older completed run holding `prior_deliveries` (ids 101.., idempotency keys explicit). `script` entries are consumed per call kind in order (deliver | ad | warehouse); {'raise': msg} raises RuntimeError(msg); an exhausted script answers success. calls = every deliverer invocation (ad snapshots are the hashed identifier dicts for adds and the stored hash payloads for removes; warehouse_export records the manifest and the JSONL lines the export held). cancellation_checks = how many cooperative checks ran; `cancel` injects a cancel request (status cancelling, error 'Cancellation requested') right BEFORE the at_check-th check, or right after the after_call-th deliverer call returned (i.e. while that request was in flight). member_page_size / ad_batch_size override the module constants (MEMBER_PAGE_SIZE 500, AD_BATCH_SIZE 5000): Go must make them configurable. NOTE: status 'completed_with_errors' (21 chars) cannot be stored in PostgreSQL's VARCHAR(20) column: on PG this flow raises DataError at the final commit (see pg_status_overflow.json); this file documents the Python code path as written (SQLite).
